_comment: RAC-378 local stuckpoint capture. MERGE this `hooks.Stop` block into your ~/.claude/settings.json (do NOT overwrite the whole file). On session stop it pipes the Stop-hook payload (incl. transcript_path) into extract-stuckpoints.mjs, which captures any stuckpoint to the agent-board. Non-blocking, exits 0 always. Set AGENT_BOARD_URL / CAPTURE_ENABLED in the command env if you need to override the defaults.
